title: [MTR4] BTS EMU B3 CRRC
description: This resource pack add BTS emu b3 into Minecraft transit railways
body:
![This is the train what i made, it maybe not the best, but it work, and if you guys can, edit a better version of my model](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b9f4907d6d409716c934f2cbb56d4780457fef3f.png)
# THE DESCRIPTION OF THE TRAIN
[MTR4] I built a full BTS‑style EMU‑B3 CRRC train for Minecraft Transit Railway, using a complete Blockbench workflow with accurate dimensions, realistic proportions, and a clean outliner structure. The model follows the standard MTR/BTS conventions, including separate groups for exterior, interior, and bogies, ensuring correct animation and compatibility with in‑game rendering.

The car body is constructed with precise scaling based on real EMU‑B3 references: a long, streamlined profile, blue lower band, grey upper body, and a continuous red roofline stripe. Doors, windows, and roof geometry are aligned to exact cube measurements to maintain consistency across all cars. The gangway between cars uses a flexible accordion design to match the real CRRC articulation style.

Both front and rear bogies are fully modeled with accurate wheel sizes, frame geometry, and correct pivot placement for smooth rotation in MTR. The texture layout uses a high‑resolution UV map, allowing clean detailing on the sides, roof, and underframe.
 
This build represents a complete, production‑ready EMU‑B3 CRRC set designed for MTR players who want a realistic, high‑quality train model that fits seamlessly into the BTS/MTR ecosystem.
